name: Warp — input/editing/keybinding stack
description: Warp's input/editing/keybinding stack: three Rust crates from Warp's bespoke `warpui` UI framework — `warpui_core` (core UI framework and keymap engine), `editor` (rich-text editing engine), and `vim` (a modal-editing library). Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
